summary: The data Amp stored for this block matches its header, and Base's node reports the same block.

checks.title: Transactions
checks.detail: 2 stored transactions rebuild the summary of them in the block's header. Amp doesn't store everything a deposit's hash covers, so Base's node supplied that, and a wrong answer would fail this.

checks.title: Results and logs

checks.title: Base's node
checks.detail: It reports the same fingerprint for this block. That's one node's word, not proof that this block is on Base's real chain.
